seo.title: Beacon | Stake Behind Recommendations
seo.description: Beacon is a decentralized discovery marketplace where people stake money behind recommendations they believe in.

home.badge: In a world of infinite content, conviction matters
home.title: Find signal through the noise.
home.description: AI is making content abundant. Attention is becoming scarce. Beacon helps readers discover books worth their time by rewarding people who back their recommendations with real conviction. No empty likes. No engagement farming. Just stronger signals.
home.tagline: Put your money where your mouth is.

support.label: To support a recommendation you believe in.

signalCard.title: Tomorrow's favorite book, discovered today
signalCard.description: Anyone can recommend a book. Few are willing to commit capital behind it. Beacon rewards conviction and helps readers separate genuine belief from empty promotion.

stepsSection.title: Put your money where your mouth is
stepsSection.description: Likes are free. Recommendations are everywhere. Beacon rewards people who are willing to back their opinions with real commitment.

recommend.title: Recommend with conviction
recommend.description: Publish a book recommendation by locking a stake. The stake is returned after the commitment period, proving you are serious about what you recommend.

support.title: Support early discoveries
support.description: Spend a small amount to back recommendations you believe deserve more attention. Your support helps quality rise above the noise.

earn.title: Earn for great taste
earn.description: When recommendations gain traction, rewards flow to the curators and early supporters who recognized quality before the crowd.

cta.title: Join the first marketplace for conviction-driven discovery.
cta.description: Beacon starts with books because great recommendations matter. Over time, the same model can help people discover films, games, podcasts, courses, products, and ideas worth their attention. Join early and help define how discovery works in an age of infinite content.
